book.name: 1 MAKOLINTE
book.title: Elin̄olo lya Paulusi no weli ku MAKOLINTE

content: Enubu no Akwetu Alumeli
Kweyi no koleko eyi etendelwa asikupumena, mu tende omu nina laelele etikeleke no Galatiya.
Eli no Sunda lyonje, omunu ni munu kwaanyi abeeke ku nyonga yaye esi ana waneke, mu ku faniketa kwesi ana biwi, nji etikoleko tileswe oku tendiwa aba niiya.
Mi abasa ni keele, aa muna kete, kame sana tume ni man̄olo, nji atwale empo yenu ku Jelusalema.
Mi nji kame saku fanene nji ni mene nite, kame saate ni mene.
Emilelo ya Paulusi
Kame sani mipotele munyima no kubita mu Masedoniya, kakuli kame ni nahana okubita endila no Masedoniya,
Mwendi kame sa ni ikale naanyi simba okwikalamo omubebo onje, nji cwale muni tuse okuta mu mwendo wange okuta oko konje sanite.
Kakuli kani singi okumimona bano mukubita fela, kame ni sepa okwikala naanyi enako icana nji Ombumu mbani lumelele.
Kono kame sani ikale mu Efese okutwala ba Pentakota,
kakuli kame nili ni kolo no kuwaba nji nitendemo omusebezi, kono cwale kame kuli aanu no kupula awo anilwisa.
Cwale Timoteya aba sakeele, mu mutambule kanyi mwabenu, kakuli kame atenda omusebezi wa Mbumu kanyi meene omo nitendela.
Cwale kulese okwikala omunu woyo so muyandisa. Mumulelubise mu mwendo waye mu kozo nji afanene okuuka kwa mene, kakuli kame nimutatelele okwiiya naasikupumena.
Kanyi ku mwabetu Apolosi kame nisinga onene nji amipotele naasikupumena anjili, kono kasingi okwiiya abano, kame saiye aba sawane esibaka.
Amaywi no Mamaneneno
Mutone, mongole mu tumelo yenu, mu tende etindume ni koongola.
Mu monise elilato mu inu yonje eyo mutenda.
Abaange, cwale, kame mulimukile nji asindoo ya Setefanasi kame ana kutenda aa no weli okupumena mu Akiya, kame ana kuku beeka onyene ku musebezi no anu no kukena a Nyambe,
kame ni mikumbela nji mukuteke aanu no ngeeso, ni kwa asikupumena onje nawo musebeza noo.
Kame nina kuwabelelwa ba kwiiya kwa Setefanasi ni Fotanatasi ni Acaikasi kakuli kame ana kwikalako aba muna kuulwa okwikalako,
kakuli kame anani katulusa wino emebo yange kanyi omo ana mikatulusete wino naanyi. Kame mufanena okukuteka aanu no ngeso.
Etikeleke namu Asiya kame timi keeta, Akwila ni Pulisika bamweya ni keleke eyo ili mu ndoo yoo kame ami keeta onene mwa Mbumu.
Abetu onje kame ami keeta. Mu kukeete mu ukutubeta no kukena.
Mene Paulusi woyo on̄ola okukeeta oko ni Lyoko lyange.
Nji omunjili kakwite elilato kwa Mbumu, mumulese akutiwe! Mbumu wetu wiiye!
Esishemo sa Mbumu Jesu Kilesite siikale naanyi.
Elilato lyange liikale naanyi monje mwa Jesu Kilesite Ameni.
